channel.description: This file is an XML representation of an issue

item.title: [IGNITE-2228] .Net: Ensure async Task can be cancelled.
item.description:
Java has IgniteFuture.cancel() method. Depending on the context, it perofrms different things. From no-op to task/closure cancellation.

We need to ensure that TPL infrastructure in .NET is able to propagate cancellation to Java future.
item.summary: .Net: Ensure async Task can be cancelled.

status.description: The issue is considered finished, the resolution is correct. Issues which are not closed can be reopened.

fixed https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/IGNITE-2157

My main concern - degraded performance for future listening. In this implementation "listen" method always return future even though users will almost never use it since cancellation is only supported for "compute".
Let's create separate pair of "listen" method which will return jobject and use them only when it is really needed.

Other minors:
1) CancelledTask - missing docs.for TaskCompletionSource field.
Reopened: need more tests for the whole compute API cancellation (Tasks work differently than closures).
